blocks.html: Living the opulent life at the luxurious Signa Designer Residences

The opulent and luxurious kind of life will soon be experienced by unit owners of the 30-storey Tower 1 of Robinsons Luxuria's Signa Designer Residences, as Robinsons Land Corporation started turning over the property to its homeowners; while the turnover of the 29-storey Tower 2 is set in October 2016.
A seamless pampered experience and boutique living is the promise of this exclusive two-tower residential development located at the heart of Makati Central Business District, which is located along Valero and Rufino streets in Salcedo Village, and sits on a prime 2570 square meter property.
Not only does Signa Designer Residences speaks of luxurious living, it also takes pride in having an architecture and design that is distinctively Filipino, and can truly compete in the international market.

Set to redefine a new standard of living in a city, this development is notable for being the first and only residential development in the country that combines the artistic philosophies of design industry powerhouses--designer Kenneth Cobonpue, architect Royal Pineda, and interior designer Budji Layug.
“Signa Designer Residences is Philippine Design interpreted in a modern way. It is influenced by what is culturally visible in our local architecture, but on a grander scale,” as said by Mybelle GoBio, senior vice president of Robinsons Residences and Robinsons Luxuria. Moreover, the criteria for its design was to create something distinctively Filipino that can truly compete in the international market.

The development boasts of being environment friendly by having a ‘Lifted Architecture’ that provides a clear open garden in the midst of the fast-paced cosmopolitan city of Makati. Its lifted floor boosts natural lighting and ventilation; spaces and alleys of streets are flooded with natural light during the day; has cross-ventilation for cool air; and has open spaces that diffuse fumes in a faster way, lessening pollution around the area.

Like living in a work of art, the upscale kind of life in Signa Designer Residences is further enhanced by the blending of opulence and efficiency of an all-suites hotel accommodation. It has expansive living spaces, versatile L-shaped kitchen in select units, and private corridors leading to the suites for exclusivity. Provisions like split-type air conditioning unit in bedrooms, dining, and living areas; engineered wood-flooring in bedrooms, and homogeneous tile flooring for the living, dining and kitchen areas; kitchen fixtures and fittings such as a granite countertop with overhead and under-counter cabinets; top-of-the-line bathroom fixtures and fittings that include glass shower partitions, rain showerhead, bathroom washbasin (countertop) and cabinet; and built-in furniture like bedroom/wardrobe closets.

Living the luxurious life at par with international standards is possible at the space of your own home through Robinsons Luxuria’s Signa Designer Residences.
